plan.archetype: Efficient attacks into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Build reliable damage and scaling, upgrade key poison or defense cards, preserve boss HP and potions, and discard or play Beckons before ending turns.
plan.summary: Secure early attack damage before adding poison scaling. Improve defense with dexterity and draw, remove weak starters, and avoid elites until sufficiently strengthened. Starter-only boss simulations show inadequate output.
